name: V.L.R Dressing

features.text: Great for tires, engines, interior and exterior surfaces.
Ready-to-use or can be diluted up to 1 part product with 2 parts water. PERFORMANCE RATING - Gloss - 7 • Durability - 4

description: A versatile, water-based dressing that protects and shines vinyl, leather, trim and tires, leaving a beautiful, rich, natural appearance. Helps protect against harmful ultraviolet rays and contaminants.
application: Shake well before using. Apply with a trigger sprayer, sponge or brush. Allow product to dry and wipe away excess from tires. Protect painted-plastic panels and never apply to steering wheels, accelerator, brake or clutch pedals.
review: Name read by hand from the header artwork
